title: add e2e tests and observability for canary/AB/shadow autorollback
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add end-to-end tests and stability/observability guards for canary/AB/shadow autorollback workflows. Improves telemetry coverage and reduces false-positive rollbacks.
description: Motivation: recent incidents showed flaky autorollback behaviour when probing/quarantine stages saw intermittent metric spikes; debugged to missing e2e coverage and incomplete telemetry for rollback decisions. This PR adds an e2e test harness that simulates staged canary, A/B and shadow traffic patterns and injects controlled metric regressions to validate automatic rollback logic. It also adds additional observability: new rollout-level metrics, taggable traces for probing/quarantine events, and dashboard alerts for quorum/metric drift. Checklist: [x] add e2e harness (pytest + local harness) [x] add deterministic metric injection controls [x] add telemetry events (rollout.probe.started, rollout.quarantine.entered, rollout.rollback.triggered) [x] update rollout engine to surface probe reasons in logs [x] add dashboard panels and alert rules [x] add unit + integration tests [x] docs: short runbook for investigating autorollbacks Changes are intentionally small in runtime: most code is tests/observability/telemetry mapping; a safe log field and a minor guard to ensure probe stage telemetry is emitted prior to rollback decision were added. See commits summary and files changed for details.
